items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: It was with Luis Russell, and it was a piece of... Nesbitt! John Nesbitt? ... the vocal with Luis Russell's band

ctx.x: So I met Zach Whyte, and joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack, and played the Savoy. And that's when I made my first record that they released. But I never got any...what do they call it...? No mentions on it. But I sang it. It was with Luis Russell, and it was a piece of...oh, I'm trying to... Nesbitt!
